# Trust root for the ledger branch.
# One signer key id per line. Keys listed here are the ONLY keys the gate will accept.
# This file lives on main, which the governance service cannot push to:
# a key that exists only on the ledger branch could re-sign a fully rewritten chain.
# The public key material for each id lives in .github/ledger-keys/<id>.pub, also on
# main: pointing --keys-dir at the ledger branch would let a rewritten ledger supply
# its own key under a trusted id and defeat this file entirely.
ledger-2026-11
